qualitative.filing_summary_8k: This 8-K, dated August 7, 2026, discloses that Teradyne, Inc. entered into a new Credit Agreement with PNC Bank, National Association as administrative agent, providing a five-year, $1.0 billion senior secured revolving credit facility for working capital and general corporate purposes. As of the filing, the company had not drawn any funds under the facility. The agreement includes customary covenants, including maximum consolidated leverage ratio and minimum interest coverage ratio requirements, with certain covenants and collateral/guarantee requirements subject to release if the company achieves an investment grade rating from at least two major rating agencies.
